_comment: Restaurants page stories (one vertical 9:16 video each), in page order. To add a story: append an entry here and its text under restaurantsPage.stories.<id> in assets/i18n/translations.json (EN/ES/RU/UK), then run npm run build:i18n. A story without 'video' shows a 9:16 placeholder; with a video, the frame takes the video's own proportions (width/height), so nothing is cropped. Desktop layout alternates automatically (odd = text left, even = video left); 'alignment' ("text-left" | "video-left") overrides it only if ever needed. 'midCtaAfter' is the story id after which the subtle mid-page CTA appears. An entry with "type": "wide" is a full-width video break (natural aspect ratio, no text, not counted in the left/right alternation); "sound": true adds a mute/unmute button (the file must contain audio).
